title: Tags
description: Custom tags for your world or server
body:
Tags provides an easy Custom TAG system using unicodes!
- Made mostly for minecraft server devs
- Has all Ranks to start a server
- More to come in the future
- pack uses unicode which is all found in the changelogs

[TAB](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/tab-1-5-1-21-8.57806/)
- Best plugin for custom TAB. (Required)

[LuckPerms](https://luckperms.net/download)
- Best plugin for managing the ranks inside the server
(Required)
